title: alpha-Cyperone (CYP) down-regulates NF-kappaB and MAPKs signaling, attenuating inflammation and extracellular matrix degradation in chondrocytes, to ameliorate osteoarthritis in mice.
authors: Zhang, Huawei; Li, Sunlong; Lu, Jiajie; Jin, Jie; Zhu, Gaosheng; Wang, Libo; Yan, Yingzhao; He, Linjie; Wang, Ben; Wang, Xiangyang; Yu, Huachen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究alpha-Cyperone通过分子对接结合NF-κB和MAPK信号蛋白抑制炎症与软骨降解，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD模拟方法，仅作为药物机制研究，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Inflammation and extracellular matrix (ECM) degradation have been implicated in the pathological process of osteoarthritis (OA). alpha-Cyperone is the main active component of the traditional Chinese medicine Cyperus rotundus L. In this study, we found that alpha-Cyperone abolished the IL-1beta-induced production of inflammatory cytokines in isolated rat chondrocytes, such as cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-alpha), interleukin-6 (IL-6) and inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS), in a dose-dependent manner (0.75, 1.5 or 3 muM). Also, the results showed that alpha-Cyperone downregulated the expression of metalloproteinases (MMPs) and thrombospondin motifs 5 (ADAMTS5), and upregulated the expression of type-2 collagen. Mechanistically, molecular docking tests revealed that alpha-Cyperone stably and effectively binds to p65, p38, extracellular signal-regulated kinase (ERK), and c-Jun N-terminal kinase (JNK). alpha-Cyperone inhibited NF-kappaB activation by blocking its nuclear transfer, and decreasing the phosphorylation of mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPKs). In addition, in vivo studies based on a mouse model of arthritis showed that alpha-Cyperone prevented the development of osteoarthritis. Therefore, alpha-Cyperone may be a potential anti-OA drug.
abstract_zh: 炎症和细胞外基质（ECM）降解已被认为与骨关节炎（OA）的病理过程相关。α-Cyperone是传统中药香附（Cyperus rotundus L.）的主要活性成分。在本研究中，我们发现α-Cyperone以剂量依赖性方式（0.75、1.5或3 μM）消除了IL-1β诱导的离体大鼠软骨细胞中炎症细胞因子的产生，如环氧化酶-2（COX-2）、肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-α）、白细胞介素-6（IL-6）和诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）。此外，结果显示α-Cyperone下调了金属蛋白酶（MMPs）和血小板反应蛋白基序5（ADAMTS5）的表达，并上调了II型胶原的表达。机制上，分子对接测试揭示α-Cyperone能稳定且有效地与p65、p38、细胞外信号调节激酶（ERK）和c-Jun N末端激酶（JNK）结合。α-Cyperone通过阻断NF-κB的核转移并减少丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPKs）的磷酸化来抑制NF-κB激活。此外，基于关节炎小鼠模型的体内研究表明，α-Cyperone阻止了骨关节炎的发展。因此，α-Cyperone可能是一种潜在的抗OA药物。
